subject: A conductor's one-line close reflection: one evidence-backed change to make in the next sprint.

dimensions.desc: Names a concrete cause and/or fix tied to a real event this sprint — not a platitude.
States something the NEXT sprint can actually do differently; a reader could act on it.
Reads as drawn from this sprint's real trajectory (grade, findings, metrics), not generic advice.

guidance: Reward a single sharp, transferable lesson. Penalize vague encouragement ('communicate better', 'be more careful'), a bare restatement of what happened with no lesson, or several unfocused lessons crammed together.
